name: domain-trust-check
description: Decide whether a domain is safe to trust or transact with — fuses RDAP registration age, DNS, SPF/DKIM/DMARC and TLS posture with live reachability, HTTP security headers, and an independent Wayback first-capture age cross-check. Paid per call via x402 through the SELAT Router (USDC via Circle Gateway).

domain.description: Bare domain to vet, no scheme and no path (used as ${domain}). Example: stripe.com

site.description: Full https:// URL of the same site, used for the reachability, security-header and archive steps (used as ${site}). Should point at the same host as ${domain}.

steps.label: registration age, DNS, email auth and TLS — x402node domain/check (x402 via SELAT Router)
live reachability and redirect chain — x402node url/check-status (x402 via SELAT Router)
HTTP security headers (HSTS/CSP/X-Frame-Options) — x402node web/headers (x402 via SELAT Router)
independent age cross-check via Wayback first capture — x402node web/archive (x402 via SELAT Router)
